Sirius is a playable character in the Grand Quest: The End of An Empire. He is the Crown Prince of Bariura Empire, and the second child of the Emperor of Bariura.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Sirius is a prodigy who mastered various academic pursuits and displayed a natural aptitude for magic from young age. When he is placed in the command of armies, his natural leadership unerringly led to victory, paving the path for his political career. To make things perfect, he is also respected and adored by his siblings. During his childhood, he came across a flashblade long forgotten in the royal treasury, and he used the blade as his weapon since then.

During the Great War, Sirius' leadership keeps the Main Gate to Bariura impenetrable. However, he suddenly leaves his post to meet his father after hearing a rumor that his father disappeared. When he arrives at the castle, it is revealed that his older sister is responsible for the rumor, in order to call Sirius back to the castle, and force him to go to another world. Sirius reluctantly obeys his older sister, then, along with her, he accompanies his father to that world to challenge its guardian. After the grievous loss that costs the Emperor’s life, Sirius leads his remaining people to find a way to go back to Grand Gaia, but their search was fruitless. Sirius then decides to settle in that world, and made peace with the guardian of that world.

sections.title: Character
sections.content: As an older brother, Sirius is respected by his younger siblings. He is also shown as a caring person, both to his siblings and to the citizens of Bariura Empire.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - In the route for gold achievement, Sirius chooses to stay in Bariura to fight Kajah with Dure, Sareas, Berdette, and Radia.

Sirius is a playable character in the Grand Quest: The End of An Empire. He is the Crown Prince of Bariura Empire, and the second child of the Emperor of Bariura.

==History==

Sirius is a prodigy who mastered various academic pursuits and displayed a natural aptitude for magic from young age. When he is placed in the command of armies, his natural leadership unerringly led to victory, paving the path for his political career. To make things perfect, he is also respected and adored by his siblings. During his childhood, he came across a flashblade long forgotten in the royal treasury, and he used the blade as his weapon since then.

During the Great War, Sirius' leadership keeps the Main Gate to Bariura impenetrable. However, he suddenly leaves his post to meet his father after hearing a rumor that his father disappeared. When he arrives at the castle, it is revealed that his[[Selvia (character)| older sister]] is responsible for the rumor, in order to call Sirius back to the castle, and force him to go to [[Vilanciel|another world]]. Sirius reluctantly obeys his older sister, then, along with her, he accompanies his father to that world to challenge its guardian. After the grievous loss that costs the Emperor’s life, Sirius leads his remaining people to find a way to go back to Grand Gaia, but their search was fruitless. Sirius then decides to settle in that world, and made peace with the [[Divine Wolf (character)|guardian]] of that world.

==Character==

As an older brother, Sirius is respected by his younger siblings. He is also shown as a caring person, both to his siblings and to the citizens of Bariura Empire.
